blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) said Friday it was verifying reports that Filipinos may have been recruited into foreign armed forces following reports that at least 14 Filipinos had been enlisted in the Russian military. “Concerned Foreign Service Posts continue to verify information through appropriate channels and coordinate with relevant authorities,”
